data.name: Stephen
data.gender_notes: Stephen is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek stephanos, 'crown, wreath'. Its root is Greek stephanos (στέφανος). Stephen, the first Christian martyr (Acts 6-7). Stephen is a Greek name meaning “Crown; wreath”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Stephen expresses “Crown; wreath”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Stephen total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
